description: Karen Varley grew up on her family's dairy farm in Iowa and built a life of service to her community. That's the Iowa way! Now, Karen is running for the Iowa House - District 23 to help ensure Madison, Adair, Union, and Clarke County citizens have a voice in legislation that impacts their life.
